input.stem: The first-order gas-phase thermal decomposition of di-tert-butyl peroxide into acetone and ethane is monitored in a closed vessel. At a temperature of 410.0 K, the initial concentration of di-tert-butyl peroxide is 0.8 mol L⁻¹, which decreases to a concentration of 0.2 mol L⁻¹ after a time elapsed of 2400.0 s. When the reaction is carried out at a temperature of 430.0 K, the rate constant is 0.00479 s⁻¹. Given R = 8.314 J K⁻¹ mol⁻¹, determine the fraction of molecules with energy ≥ E_a at a temperature of 750.0 K.
